chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Cab's book blames Milt for the spitball, but it was Dizzy
summary: Milt shows that Cab's book says he threw the spitball, while Danny and Milt recall it was Dizzy Gillespie, who made spitballs in Cab's band.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Were you in the band, Danny, when the spitball...
Yeah, I was there.
Sure.

Everyone there used to look at it and throw it out, hit people behind the head... We'd be on the stairs by the footlights, you know, playing, and the rest of the guys who'd be in the band, a couple of them, throwing spitballs at us. They'd (?) all the arrangements; all the different arrangements were (?)ripped up(?).
That's true, man?
Yes, sir. Well, that's what we got bawled out about. But this was the one time that Dizzy didn't do it.
That's right. Jonah did it.
Jonah did it. Dizzy didn't do it.
He could have stopped all that if he had just said, 'I did it.'
Yes, immediately. I'm so glad, because that story has been told a million ways -- and you're here. Have you read Cab's book, Me And Minnie The Moocher?
Yeah, I've got it here.
Barker - V-60
Yeah. Well, you see where he says that I threw the spitball?
I think so, yes.

Now, how could I throw it when it landed on the stage beside us, out there on the stage, you know. Well, I know why he didn't want to put it in the book. Because he and Jonah were having a little argument at that time, and the guy who was writing the book, he didn't want to put anything in there derogatory about him, and he knew that I'm a friend, and it don't make no difference to me what they say, because I still love Cab -- you know, I love him.
He figured you would understand.

So the kid... I think the kid that was, you know, ghostwriting the book for him said, 'Well, we've got to have the end of this story.' So he said, 'Fifteen years later, Milt Hinton admitted that he threw the spitball' -- which is not true, of course, at all.
Uh-huh.
But I'm glad that you was there, because you were a witness to that, too.
You know, Jonah used to (?)tell us(?) to make them spitballs. You know, he was a restless kid. But we liked him because he would always speak of us as the two
Barker - V-61
...(?)...(?)...(?)... Because we didn't care. We could understand, because...
And he showed me them cards, he was on them slightly different(?) (?), too.
Yes.
The (?) everything about it was that "Girl Of My Dreams," which was a tune I was playing as a bass solo. You remember that?
Yes.
The one who threw the spitball used to be a musician, too?
Yeah, he was a trumpet player. He was in the band. Famous. Dizzy Gillespie.
You know Dizzy Gillespie. Dizzy Gillespie, now that's who they're speaking of.
That's who they're talking about?
He was in the band with us.
Well, I'll be doggoned!
